comment: Single source of truth for which skills are active on this machine.
Edit this file, then run ./install.sh to reconcile ~/.claude/skills/.
owned:    skills in this repository; linked to skills/<name>.
external: third-party skills managed by the skill installer in ~/.agents/skills.
They are NOT copied into this repository, so they keep receiving upstream
updates. Only their active/disabled state is decided here.
disabled: reason is mandatory. install.sh removes their link from ~/.claude/skills;
the source stays in ~/.agents/skills and can be re-enabled by flipping
unmanaged_ignore: entries in the target directory that this script must report as expected and never touch. 'synced' is Claude's own account-synced skill cache.

owned.name: agentic-coder
owned.role: Production code: implement, debug, review a diff, verify.

owned.name: evo-memory
owned.role: A persistent learning layer that accumulates research knowledge across ideation and experimentation cycles

external.name: code-review
external.role: Two-axis review of a whole branch or PR via parallel sub-agents.
external.boundary: Owns branch/PR scope. agentic-coder/references/code-review.md owns reviewing a single visible change.

external.name: simplify
external.role: Reduce a change to its smallest clear form.
external.boundary: Invoked explicitly, usually before a commit. agentic-coder prevents over-engineering while writing; this removes it afterwards.

external.name: teach
external.role: Stateful teaching workspace: MISSION.md, HTML lessons, learning records on disk.
external.boundary: Manual only (disable-model-invocation). personal-ta owns in-conversation teaching.

external.name: improve
external.role: Read-only codebase audit that emits implementation plans for other agents.

external.name: docs-pro
external.role: Standalone documentation authoring and style enforcement.
external.boundary: Owns documentation as a deliverable. agentic-coder only covers docs that ship alongside a code change.

external.name: pdf
external.reason: Claude already syncs the same upstream skill as anthropic-skills:pdf (see the 'synced' cache). Two copies of one skill on identical triggers.

external.name: data-visualization
external.role: Charts and figures with matplotlib, seaborn, plotly.
external.boundary: Owns Python figures for papers and reports (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly). Claude's synced 'dataviz' skill owns charts rendered inside artifacts.

external.name: socratic-tutor
external.reason: Duplicates personal-ta: same 0-5 skill map, diagnostic placement, one-question loop, and final assessment, on the same 'teach me' / 'quiz me' triggers. personal-ta is a superset and adds research mentorship.
